name: Vaux-C2 Module
description: Extraction Laser Power: 120% Optimal Charge Rate: -15% The Vaux-C2 Module from Shubin Interstellar reduces the charge rate when mining but makes extracting valuable ore faster.

name: Vaux-C3 Module
description: Extraction Laser Power: 125% Optimal Charge Rate: -5% The Vaux-C3 Module from Shubin Interstellar reduces the charge rate when mining but makes extracting valuable ore faster.

name: Vaux Module
description: Extraction Laser Power: 115% Optimal Charge Rate: -20% The Vaux Module from Shubin Interstellar reduces the charge rate when mining but makes extracting valuable ore faster.

name: Veil
description: An advanced cooling system significantly reduces the heat produced by the Veil stealth shield generator. No other component in its class even comes close to rivaling its heat suppression technology.

name: Vertine QD
description: Internally designed by Wei-Tek for the Sabre Raven EX, the Vertine Quantum Dampener generates a field that prevents quantum drive activation and helps ensures that hostile targets can't escape.

name: Vesta
description: Ensure your goods get to where they need to go with the Vesta quantum drive. Juno Starwerk specifically designed the component to handle all the trials and tribulations of the long haul.

name: Vigilance
description: Vigilance means keeping a careful watch for any possible dangerous threats and the GNP radar that bears this name allows you to do just that with its proprietary emission accrual.

name: Viper III-G Missile
description: Nova has worked hard to insure that their infrared tracking Viper strike missile lives up to its name by delivering agile and lethal attacks against hostile targets. Note: This missile may only be launched by ground vehicles.

name: Viper III Missile
description: Nova has worked hard to insure that their infrared tracking Viper strike missile lives up to its name by delivering agile and lethal attacks against hostile targets.

name: ViseLock S1 Tractor Beam
description: The ViseLock tractor beam is an evolution of Greycat’s industry-standard tech, with added improvements specifically intended to help security forces restrain their targets. In its design, Greycat sacrificed some hold strength at greater distances to achieve a more powerful tether that is harder to escape.

name: ViseLock S2 Tractor Beam
description: The ViseLock tractor beam is an evolution of Greycat’s industry-standard tech, with added improvements specifically intended to help security forces restrain their targets. In its design, Greycat sacrificed some hold strength at greater distances to achieve a more powerful tether that is harder to escape.

name: ViseLock S3 Tractor Beam
description: The ViseLock tractor beam is an evolution of Greycat’s industry-standard tech, with added improvements specifically intended to help security forces restrain their targets. In its design, Greycat sacrificed some hold strength at greater distances to achieve a more powerful tether that is harder to escape.

name: VK-00
description: When the stakes are high, Wei-Tek’s advanced VK-00 quantum drive is the only choice you should trust to get you where you need to be.

name: Vogel
description: As you ride to destinations new and afar, uncover the unknown with the Vogel radar from WillsOp that features innovative signature filtration and detection algorithms.

name: Voir
description: The Voir is not just for the military anymore. Now you too can attach this small radar to your ship to stay safe.

name: Vortex
description: Turn the tide of battle with the Aegis Vortex. Counted on by the UEE Navy, this power plant can be found on ships defending every corner of the universe.

name: Voyage
description: Crafted by passionate people who have been leading the way in space exploration and travel for over six centuries, the Voyage by Tarsus is a quantum drive worthy of your next expedition.

name: VT-T10 "Veritas" Torpedo
description: Bring Behring's expert engineering to bear with the VT-T10 "Veritas" Torpedo. Originally designed for the Polaris, this size 10 torpedo has earned a reputation as a dependable and incredibly powerful ordnance.

name: Vulcan
description: Juno Starwerk designed the Vulcan to be both cost efficient and durable. It won’t win any awards for its performance but can be trusted to get you to your destination.

name: Vulture 2953 Best in Show Livery
description: Celebrate the Drake Vulture being voted a Best in Show finalist for 2953 with this pearlescent purple and cyan livery.

name: Vulture Abomination Livery
description: The Abomination livery brings out the Vulture's already brutish features, boasting an asymmetrical arrangement of green and blue paneling to mimic the monsters that still haunt our imaginations.

name: Vulture Assembly Livery
description: Make them see red! The Assembly livery is a full fuselage red design with black and silver accents that makes sure your spacecraft is easily identifiable during salvage operations.

name: Vulture Carbonide Livery
description: When salvage operations need to be done quietly, the Carbonide livery offers a distinct grey-on-grey alternating layout intended to obscure the spacecraft against a usual starfield.

name: Vulture Carnival Livery
description: A working salvage crew needs any advantage they can get to be noticed in a busy environment. Enter the Carnival livery, a stunning pink hull with black highlights and distinctive stripes running down the ship's arms.

name: Vulture Deck the Hull Livery
description: Express your holiday spirit with the Deck the Hull livery, which uses the traditional Luminalia colors of green and red to celebrate the popular Banu festival that's become beloved by Humans.

name: Vulture Dying Star Livery (Modified)
description: This version of the livery has been modified from its original form with the addition of graffiti. Sold in 2943 to celebrate the 450th anniversary of Pyro's discovery, the Dying Star livery is tan with brown and black highlights. It also features branding from Pyrotechnic Amalgamated, the now defunct mining company that found and named the system.

name: Vulture Foundation Guide Livery
description: Foundation Festival is an opportunity for Citizens and Civilians to come together and strengthen the foundation of our community. Show your commitment to a better universe with this custom livery.

name: Vulture Ghoulish Green Livery
description: Embrace Day of the Vara mischievousness and mayhem any time of the year with this custom Vulture livery. It combines metallic green and black for a striking look that highlights the holiday's classic colors.

name: Vulture Heartthrob Livery
description: Make people weak in the knees by adorning the Vulture with the Hearthrob livery, featuring a shimmering violet paint scheme.

name: Vulture IceBreak Livery
description: Equip your Vulture with a paint scheme cooler than a snow storm. The IceBreak livery mixes crisp, cool white with a frostbitten blue for an exciting look suitable for any season.

name: Vulture Longhorn Livery
description: For the Vulture captain dedicated to a hard day's work, the Longhorn livery's black-and-burnt orange hull with rough silver highlights lend a classic industrial feel to the famed spacecraft.

name: Vulture Oriole Livery
description: The Oriole livery offers Vulture captains a no-nonsense matte grey toned hull patterned after those operated by military organizations. Understated orange highlights mark the craft's salvage-and-recovery role.

name: Vulture Outcast Livery (Modified)
description: This version of the livery has been modified from its original form with the addition of graffiti. Embrace chaos with the Outcast livery. It features rough splashes of neon green against black to give the Vulture an aggressively chaotic appearance.

name: Vulture Pyrite Livery
description: Vulture operators who choose the Pyrite livery never have to apologize for sporting a little style. A stealthy matte black and silver hull contrasts sharply with silver and yellow topped arms.

name: Vulture Skullcrusher Livery
description: Exude attitude with the Skullcrusher livery for the Vulture, which features a massive skull across the top.

name: Wanderer
description: Tarsus carefully designed and tuned the Wanderer into an all-around solid quantum drive, making it one of the more popular components in their revered line-up.

name: 'WAR' Cannon
description: This neutron cannon is typically found on Vanduul war ships and is commonly known by its UEE Navy designation of 'WAR'.

name: Ward
description: The Ward is Basilisk’s basic industrial-grade shield generator for large ships. It provides decent performance and durability while also keeping its signature respectable.

name: 'WARLORD' Cannon
description: 'WARLORD' Cannon

name: 'WASP' Repeater
description: This laser repeater is typically found on Vanduul war ships and is commonly known by its UEE Navy designation of 'WASP'.

name: Wayfare
description: Speed through space without breaking the bank. The Warfare is a small quantum drive from Tarsus that was specifically designed to help make space travel affordable for the masses.

name: 'WEAK' Repeater
description: This laser repeater is typically found on Vanduul war ships and is commonly known by its UEE Navy designation of 'WEAK'.

name: WEB
description: Tried, tested, and refined for centuries, the WEB shield generator balances sleek design with stellar performance to keep your ship safe under a wide variety of circumstances.

name: 'WHIP' Cannon
description: 'WHIP' Cannon

name: Whiptail STR-E2 Repeater
description: Designed for the Stringray to unleash a torrent of laser fire, this custom made laser repeater is capable of firing in rapid succession to strip away defenses.

name: WhiteOut
description: Your ship faces a lot of extreme conditions while flying. From the coldness of space to the burning heat of a desert planet, the last thing you want to worry about is if your cooler can keep up. The entry-level WhiteOut from Lightning Power provides thermal management that can help make sure you get where you’re going.

name: WhiteRose
description: Pull incredible performance from the WhiteRose. This small power plant from Sakura Sun shines when generating the kind of power that leaves the other small power plants in its wake.

name: WillsOp Long Look Radar
description: When the UEEN came to Anvil needing a ship to handle mobile C&C, Anvil turned to WillsOp, one of the most trusted names in scanning and deep-space radar. Together they developed the Long Look Radar (LLR) system as a way to upgrade the modern Hornets rather than developing an entirely new ship. Fully loaded with WillsOp’s suite of scan systems, the LLR now brings its raw analytical power to the civilian market, turning an already dependable vessel into a perfect scanning fighter.

name: Winter-Star
description: Join the J-Span family by snagging the Winter-Star cooler for your ship. This entry-level model lacks flash but its strong performance record and price point make it a popular choice for pilots across the UEE.

name: Winter-Star EX
description: The Winter-Star EX is a baseline cooler you can trust. Built by the experts at J-Span, it’s ready to handle whatever conditions you encounter.

name: Winter-Star SL
description: The latest in J-Span’s Winter-Star line of coolers, the SL’s new Kivo system offers a unique dispersal method, allowing your vehicle to manage heat better than ever before.

name: Winter-Star XL
description: For two centuries, J-Span has dedicated itself to manufacturing coolers. The Winter-Star XL is their entry level large cooler. What it lacks in features, it more than makes up for in solid craftsmanship.

name: Wolf Allegro Livery
description: With a look inspired by racing ships, the Allegro livery spotlights the sleek, aerodynamic design of the Wolf.

name: Wolf Antilles Livery
description: The Antilles livery for the Wolf features a vibrant, electric blue base paint and bright red tail section.

name: Wolf Frost Camo Livery
description: The Frost Camo livery is crisp white with a subtle camo pattern and grey and red highlights.

name: Wolf Heatsink Livery
description: The Heatsink livery features a two-tone striped blue base paint with bold yellow and red highlights.

name: Wolf HighSec Livery
description: The HighSec livery gives the Wolf a carbon fiber finish with red accents.

name: Wolf Iceflash Livery
description: The Iceflash livery provides the Wolf a distinct look with grey spots breaking up its grey and white base paint.

name: Wolf Lycan Livery
description: Stalk your prey with the exclusive Lycan livery, which features a black base and gray fur-like hand-painted details for a monstrous finish.

name: Wolf Nightbreak Livery
description: Discreetly soar through the night sky in the Wolf with the Nightbreak livery, which is primarily black with red highlights.

name: Wolf Nighttide Camo Livery
description: Orange highlights provide a bit of color to the gray and black Nighttide Camo livery.

name: Wolf Ranger Camo Livery
description: Mixing a green camo pattern on the front with a bright yellow back makes the Ranger Camo an attention-getting choice for the Wolf.

name: Wolf Riftwalker Livery
description: Complement the elegant design of the Kruger Wolf with the Riftwalker livery, which is primarily black with bronze and blue highlights.

name: Wolf Rosso Livery
description: Live bright and bold with the stark red of the Rosso livery and ensure that everyone will see the unique beauty of the Kruger Wolf.

name: Wolf Sylvan Camo Livery
description: Brandish a green and brown camo pattern with red and yellow highlights on the Kruger Wolf with the Sylvan Camo livery.

name: 'WRATH' Cannon
description: This laser repeater is typically found on Vanduul war ships and is commonly known by its UEE Navy designation of 'WRATH'.

name: 'WRATH' Cannon
description: This laser repeater is typically found on Vanduul war ships and is commonly known by its UEE Navy designation of 'WRATH'.

name: X1 2954 Auspicious Red Dog Livery
description: Seek peace and prosperity in the new year with the Auspicious Red Dog livery. Outfit your ship with this bold red base paint complemented by gold accents and a stylized graphic of a dog.

name: X1 2954 Auspicious Red Dragon Livery
description: Seek peace and prosperity in the new year with the Auspicious Red Dragon livery. Outfit your ship with this bold red base paint complemented by gold accents and a stylized graphic of a dragon.

name: X1 Blueshift Livery
description: Infinity Custom worked with Origin on the Blueshift livery, which is dark blue and black with X1 in vibrant white.

name: X1 Scarlet Livery
description: Infinity Custom worked closely with Origin to develop the exclusive Scarlet livery, which enhances the striking look of the X1 with bold red accents.

name: X1 Shadow Livery
description: Infinity Custom worked with Origin on the Shadow livery for the X1, which is primarily black with grey lettering and orange highlights.

name: X1 Supersonic Livery
description: Infinity Custom worked with Origin to design the Supersonic livery for the X1. It is grey with orange highlights to accent the vehicle's streamlined design.

name: XL-1
description: Wei-Tek might be a new company, but their line of military-grade components is already gaining notoriety. The XL-1 is their premier medium quantum drive that expertly blends performance and durability.

name: XTR-L Module
description: Optimal Charge Window Size: +22% Inert Material Level: -5.7% Extraction Laser Power: 90% The XTR-L Module creates a wider mining window for deposits. It also makes the extraction laser less powerful so it can filter out more inert materials.

name: XTR Module
description: Optimal Charge Window Size: +15% Inert Material Level: -5% Extraction Laser Power: 85% The XTR Module creates a wider mining window for deposits. It also makes the extraction laser less powerful so it can filter out more inert materials.

name: XTR-XL Module
description: Optimal Charge Window Size: +25% Inert Material Level: -6% Extraction Laser Power: 95% The XTR-XL Module creates a wider mining window for deposits. It also makes the extraction laser less powerful so it can filter out more inert materials.

name: Yaluk
description: The bigger the haul, the harder your quantum drive has to work. With Juno Starwerk’s Yaluk onboard, you’ll know that you have a quantum drive that is up to the challenge of getting the job done.

name: Yeager
description: Whether you’re rushing to the rescue or simply patrolling through a sector, the Yeager quantum drive from Wei-Tek allows for greater performance when you need it most.

name: Yebira I
description: The Yebira I rocket pod is the perfect system for efficient deployment of S3 ordnance. Manufactured by Firestorm Kinetics, this rocket pod carries three rockets and attaches to any size one hardpoint.

name: Yebira II
description: The Yebira II rocket pod is the perfect system for efficient deployment of S3 ordnance. Manufactured by Firestorm Kinetics, this rocket pod carries six rockets and attaches to any size two hardpoint.

name: YellowJacket GT-210 Gatling
description: While the GT-210 YellowJacket may be small, it packs a mighty sting. This high-speed ballistic weapon is perfect for targeting smaller, more mobile targets and its DTX-8 ammo supply system almost completely eliminates weapon jams due to bad rounds.

name: Yeng’tu Repeater
description: Inspired by Xi'an mil-tech and tailor-made by Torral Aggregate exclusively for the Aopoa San'tok.yāi, the Yeng'tu laser repeater accentuates the ship's dexterity with a fighter's edge.

name: ZapJet
description: The Lightning Power ZapJet is an ideal streamlined package perfect for anybody who wants a straightforward no-fuss power solution.

name: Zephyr
description: By minimizing emissions through an advanced reduced outflow filtration process, the RAMP Zephyr quantum drive helps ensure privacy while traveling wherever you go.

name: ZeroRush
description: Few things can push your ship to its limits like racing. Going faster and harder generates a lot of excess heat that can take a toll on your system if not properly managed. The ZeroRush cooler from ACOM has what it takes to get you across the finish line.

name: Zeus ArcCorp Livery
description: The ArcCorp livery for the Zeus features the company's logo atop a maroon base paint with black and yellow highlights.

name: Zeus Best in Show 2955 Livery
description: Commemorate the Zeus making the final four of the 2955 Ship Showdown with this striking metallic orange and black Best in Show livery.

name: Zeus Citizens for Prosperity Garnet Livery
description: Join the Citizens for Prosperity in their mission to bring peace to the frontier with this dark grey and burgandy livery featuring the group's signature logo.

name: Zeus Crusader Livery
description: The Crusader livery for the Zeus features the company's logo atop a light blue base paint with black and white highlights.

name: Zeus Frontier Fighters Camo Livery
description: Be ready to battle in the untamed wilds with this green camo livery featuring the logo of the Frontier Fighters vigilante group.

name: Zeus Headhunters Trauma Livery
description: Show your loyalty to the Headhunters gang with this livery featuring their logo emblazoned on a dark grey hull accented with a vibrant purple.

name: Zeus Hurston Livery
description: The Hurston livery for the Zeus features the company's logo atop a grey base paint with yellow highlights.

name: Zeus Keelback Livery
description: Venture forth with the Keelback livery, utilizing a deep blue with contrasting yellow accents.

name: Zeus Lovestruck Livery
description: Inspired by the colors of Coramor, the Lovestruck livery is a stylish metallic pink and black look for your Zeus.

name: Zeus microTech Livery
description: The microTech livery for the Zeus features the company's logo atop a white base paint with light blue and grey highlights.

name: Zeus Mk II CL PHB Flight Blade
description: Unlock the potential of your RSI Zeus Mk II CL with the PHB Flight Blade from Broad & Rabiee. By re-allocating forward thrust resources, you can expect your ship to deliver increased precision handling during tight maneuvers.

name: Zeus Mk II CL Standard Flight Blade
description: This is the standard issue flight blade for the Zeus Mk II CL.

name: Zeus Mk II CL TSB Flight Blade
description: Unlock the potential of your RSI Zeus Mk II CL with the TSB Flight Blade from Broad & Rabiee. By re-allocating lateral thrust resources, you can expect your ship to deliver increased top speeds in the straightaway.

name: Zeus Mk II ES PHB Flight Blade
description: Unlock the potential of your RSI Zeus Mk II ES with the PHB Flight Blade from Broad & Rabiee. By re-allocating forward thrust resources, you can expect your ship to deliver increased precision handling during tight maneuvers.

name: Zeus Mk II ES Standard Flight Blade
description: This is the standard issue flight blade for the Zeus Mk II ES.

name: Zeus Mk II ES TSB Flight Blade
description: Unlock the potential of your RSI Zeus Mk II ES with the TSB Flight Blade from Broad & Rabiee. By re-allocating lateral thrust resources, you can expect your ship to deliver increased top speeds in the straightaway.

name: Zeus Mk II Firmament Livery
description: The Firmament livery makes the Zeus Mk II a beautiful light blue with black and white highlights.

name: Zeus Mk II Frontier Livery
description: The Frontier livery highlights the dynamic angular design of the Zeus Mk II. The white in the front extends into the grey back half of the ship down the center of the fuselage and edge of each wing.

name: Zeus Mk II Monteverde Livery
description: Featuring a lush green with yellow and black highlights, the Monteverde livery gives you a colorful option for the Zeus Mk II.

name: Zeus Mk II Obsidian Livery
description: The Obsidian livery uses black, white, and a metallic finish to give the Zeus Mk II a distinctly bold look.

name: Zeus MK II Purple Haze Livery
description: Celebrate Day of the Vara in style with the Purple Haze livery, featuring a glimmering metallic purple base paint splattered in green.

name: Zeus MK II Solar Livery
description: Primarily orange with a grey central line and highlights, the Solar livery for the Zeus Mk II was designed to match the colors of the iconic Zeus suit variant of the same name.

name: Zeus Mk II Solstice Livery
description: Outfit the ship that launched Humanity into the stars with the gorgeous Solstice livery. Grey and black panels accented by ribbons of gold give the Zeus Mk II a distinguished and unforgettable appearance.

name: Zeus MK II Starscape Livery
description: The subtle style of the Starscape livery features black and steel-colored panels with orange highlights.

name: Zeus Mk II Sunswept Livery
description: Proclaim your presence with the Sunswept livery for the Zeus Mk II, which features a vibrant yellow with black highlights.

name: Zeus XenoThreat Purge Livery
description: Let Humanity know you won't bow down to alien invaders with this XenoThreat livery featuring a muted teal with bright red accents.
